status: PROVISIONAL NUMERICAL REQUIREMENTS STUDY; NO FABRICATION OR POWERED RELEASE

sampling.limits: Sampled study, not continuous extrema or collision proof; command acceleration excluded.

moment_equation: M_required=J_p*beta_ddot+(m*r_COM)x a_pivot; native chord is arm direction+pi. Aerodynamic/bearing terms added by absolute bounds.

combined_proposed_bound.limits: Triangle bounds allow each blade mass moment/inertia to vary independently below proposed caps. Sampled geometric coefficients and assumed friction/aero; distributed linkage inertia and command transients remain excluded.
combined_proposed_bound.R12_jacobian_bound_basis: R12/L40 slider crank, +/-45deg: |dx/dtheta| <=12.1mm/rad; verify physical travel after redesign.

stops_and_jams.decision: Rigid jam load is not bounded by steady servo/drive torque. Measure rotor inertia and qualify containment/retention; no intentional full-speed jam test.

excluded_or_unverified: blade/arm/rod mass distribution and inertia measured from final construction
arm and rod distributed rotating inertia and gravity orientation
aerodynamic transient, induced velocity and hinge moment inputs
XY command acceleration and actuator feedback bandwidth
bearing reaction distribution with COM offset and structural flexibility
rotor inertia/containment evidence and physical tests
